notes.title: Community Update!
notes.content:
Draw a Stickman: Epic 2 has just been updated with new features to allow Steam users to share drawings to and use drawings from the Epic 2 Art Gallery. Display your stickmen, their friends, your swords, and more on our community gallery, and select drawings from other players across all platforms to use in your adventure!

In addition to this major feature, we've also fixed a number of bugs with the Sketchbook UI and collision in various chapters as well as a major bug that could cause users to become stuck at the end of Chapter 7.
